scope: Remove the adapter's internal playback-authority option, constructor argument, state, and conditional completion/deadline branches
acceptance_criteria: No playback-authority flag, opt-in option, or replacement switch remains in runtime code
Valid playback receipts complete audio messages and emit once-only completion metrics and idle-start packets without opt-in
Message identity, terminal delivery, text closure, send failure, pause, interruption, and duplicate checks remain unchanged
Missing receipts use the existing timeout path without opt-in
Empty and text-only messages retain their existing completion behavior
No changes to streamer methods, protobuf messages, transport implementations, or caller construction sites are required
risks: All audio streams must honor the playback callback contract. Missing callbacks now fail on the existing deadline rather than remaining diagnostic-only.
This supersedes the earlier optional-activation proposal, not the safeguards validating message completion.
Historical RFC and review artifacts describe prior revisions and remain preserved.
verification_commands: just agent-finalize with the exact allowed_paths inventory
rollback: Revert only this follow-up diff to restore the earlier optional completion gate

independent_review.summary: Independent read-only review confirmed consistent signatures, no remaining runtime gate, unchanged completion safeguards, and coverage for default completion and missing-receipt timeout. Test execution and finalizer were coordinator-owned.
